caption: The drawing contains six square patterns arranged in two rows and three columns against a beige background. The top left square features a brown and white plaid pattern with thin green vertical lines at the left and right edges. The top center square displays a black and white zigzag or chevron pattern with red dots scattered throughout. The top right square shows a brown background with a fine crosshatch and an overlay of large white floral designs. The bottom left square has a tartan-style plaid pattern composed of black, red, gray, and white lines intersecting at right angles. The bottom center square consists of a white background with vertical black dashed and dotted lines evenly spaced across the surface. The bottom right square presents a brown and beige plaid pattern with diagonally oriented lines and some bold, dark brown rectangular elements within the plaid.
title: Materials from Quilt
